identity.title: [v0.91.8][provider] Route Kimi and MiniMax through adl-provider-adapter

values.goal: Add reliable Rust-native hosted adapter routes for Kimi/Moonshot and MiniMax.
values.required_outcome: Typed Kimi and MiniMax dispatch, bounded request contracts, provider error classification, focused tests, and live credentialed probe evidence.
authority_boundary: The adapter owns request routing, bounded payloads, response extraction, and typed provider failures; it does not provision credentials or alter lifecycle policy.
